model_notes: Baseline accepted: withdrawal / P2 / Payments. TX-86735 is 120.00 USD via QuickPay, created 2026-09-22T02:10Z, updated 2026-09-26T11:30Z, status completed. `completed` means the provider confirmed it — it does NOT mean the customer has received it, and the customer says it has not reached her e-wallet. This is a completed-but-receipt-disputed case: the required action is verification of the payment/receipt (provider reference, destination e-wallet, trace), NOT a reissue and NOT a second payment. Must not tell her the concern is resolved, must not say the money is definitely on its way, and must not claim a new payment. The closed prior ticket T-5015 told her "up to 5 days" — an unsupported promise; per the current handbook, processing is 24h then 1-3 business days, and that earlier advice should not be repeated. Finance context shows a QuickPay settlement incident 20-24 Sep touching delayed withdrawals; this is context only. The 2 Oct internal target must not be given to the customer. This ticket is related to, but not a duplicate of, T-5015 (closed). Escalation required.
